official: 横浜市特定乳児等通園支援事業の運営の基準に関する条例の制定

sources.label: 議案一覧（令和8年第1回定例会）

name: 通園支援事業の運営基準を定める
summary: 子ども・子育て支援法の一部改正を受け、横浜市が特定乳児等通園支援事業の運営基準を定めます。国の府令に沿った基準を置き、事業者が暴力団などに当たらないことを定めます。条例は令和8年4月1日に施行されます。
changes: 事業の運営基準を内閣府令に沿って定める
暴力団等に該当する者や密接な関係者を事業者から除く
who: 特定乳児等通園支援事業を運営する事業者
why: 子ども・子育て支援法の一部改正に伴い、事業の運営基準を定めるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Sets operating standards for childcare attendance support services
en.official: Ordinance Establishing Standards for the Operation of Yokohama City Specified Infant and Other Childcare Attendance Support Services
en.summary: In response to a partial amendment to the Child and Child-Rearing Support Act, Yokohama City will set operating standards for specified infant and other childcare attendance support services. The city will establish standards in line with the Cabinet Office Order and require that providers are not members of organized crime groups, etc. The ordinance will take effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Sets operating standards for the service in line with the Cabinet Office Order
Excludes people who are members of organized crime groups, etc., or closely connected to them from being providers
who: Providers operating specified infant and other childcare attendance support services
en.why: The city says this is to establish operating standards for the service following a partial amendment to the Child and Child-Rearing Support Act.
